name: Shopify Merge product sync Pipeline (GraphQL) - Process Product

parameters.content:
## Process Product (sub-workflow)

Extracted from **Shopify Merge product sync Pipeline (GraphQL)** to fix a confirmed n8n platform bug in the Loop Over Items (Split In Batches) node: when the same SplitInBatches node is triggered more than once within an execution (which is exactly what happened -- Process Each Product was fed once per sheet by the outer loop), its internal state goes stale after the first activation and every later activation silently processes almost nothing (confirmed live: 289 runs, only 2 produced output). n8n's own fix for this (PR #23775) was closed without being merged, so there's no version upgrade that resolves it.

This sub-workflow does the full per-product work -- create/update, image sync, collections, metafields, publish -- for exactly ONE item. The main pipeline calls it via an Execute Sub-workflow node in "Run once for each item" mode instead of using a second SplitInBatches node, which sidesteps the buggy code path entirely: each call is a fresh execution with its own clean state.

**Image sync (one file per image):** runs only when `Fields_to_update` has an IMAGE URL token. `Find Original Files` looks up the Shopify File behind each sheet URL; `Build GraphQL: Sync Product Images` attaches that same file to the product by ID (no copy, so the sheet URL = the product URL), deletes replaced files the product owns (name starts with the product number, or an old `_<uuid>` copy), only detaches anything else, never changes the alt of the shared CAD file, and re-orders the gallery to sheet order. A sheet URL with no matching Shopify File stops the run with an error naming the slot; a file still processing is skipped until the next run.

**One-time setup after importing both files:** open the main pipeline's "▶️ Process Product (per item)" node and select this workflow from the dropdown -- its ID doesn't exist yet at export time so it can't be pre-linked.

**Gallery order stage (2026-10-23):** after fireplace feature photos changed on the live store, the image sync no longer sends the reorder together with attach/delete. Execution 27034 (LSBLD358): attach 8 originals + delete 8 copies + reorder in one go left the gallery as 5,6,7,CAD,1,2,3,4 -- Shopify applies attach/delete asynchronously, so the reorder arrived early and a failed reorder was ignored. Now: Collect Sync Results -> wait 15s -> read media -> if any wanted file is not on the product yet, wait 30s and read again -> move only the files that are present into sheet order -> wait -> read -> Verify Gallery Order (records reorderVerified true/false; never silent).
